findings.description: The KMS key used for the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so the key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived static key material increases the blast radius if the key is ever compromised and weakens cryptographic hygiene for audit log data.

No explicit policy argument is supplied, so AWS applies the default KMS key policy that delegates full key access to the account root, allowing any IAM principal in the account with kms:* permissions to decrypt audit trail data. A least-privilege key policy should scope decrypt/admin rights to specific principals.
